title: Provenance
description: Metadata carried by every record so its origin can always be traced. Contains no domain-specific fields.

system.description: Originating system, e.g. an archiver, a PLC, a file export, a generator.

instrument.description: Sensor, digitizer or logger that produced the data.

uri.description: File path or URL of the original data.

license.description: License or terms of use for externally sourced data.

asset.description: The physical or logical thing the record describes.

domain.description: Free-text engineering domain label, e.g. rf, mechanical, plc, environmental. Never used for branching logic.

operating_mode.description: State the asset was in, e.g. operating, standby, maintenance.

configuration.description: Free-form key/value snapshot of settings in effect at acquisition time.

acquired_at.description: When the data was captured (UTC, ISO 8601).

synthetic.description: True if the record was produced by the synthetic generator.

generator.description: Present when synthetic is true; makes the record reproducible.

checksum.description: Hash of the original payload, e.g. sha256:...
